features.name: Omen of War

review:
Respins plus a coin reveal. Any win triggers a Goddess Respin and marks its symbols with Flaming Frames, and the respins continue while wins grow. If a Fortune symbol is on the grid when they end, every frame flips.

Frames reveal bronze, silver or gold coins, shields that boost nearby or all coins, or amphoras that collect everything. In the Omen of War bonus, frames stay active after they're used, so the board fills up. A richer take on the Le Pharaoh idea. 15,000x max.
